title: Hackers compromise 14,500 Dahua web cameras in 35-day campaign
summary: According to their findings, the 35-day CameraSwarm campaign compromised 14,530 Dahua IP cameras using three attack methods in parallel: The recovery code generation mechanism in the attack toolkit leverages the camera serial number, which allows the CameraSwarm operator to redeem new codes…
